verdict.rationale: Stripe's docs describe capturing government ID photos through a conversion-optimized verification flow. A community user reports the image analysis runs in the browser and the flow hands off smoothly from desktop to phone, which suggests some guided web capture. missing for 10: any evidence of native iOS or Android SDKs, documented glare/blur/edge-detection coaching, and first-try capture success metrics.

support.subject: As a developer, I get native iOS, Android, and web SDKs with guided camera capture — glare, blur, and edge detection coaching the user to a usable document photo on the first try

citations.quote: Capture government-issued photo IDs with a conversion-optimized verification flow
It does all the image analysis in browser without the need for a native app.
the identity product has some great UX, they rarely get stuck on it
